units.translation: The rhythms in the whole choral song are predominantly trochees, mostly, as usual, catalectic dimeters. So it was also in the stasima, except that in those, toward the end, tragic pathos came to expression in iambs; here there was no place for that. Therefore in this first strophe, as the third-from-last colon, ⟦1⟧, an iambic hexapody, cannot stand; rather one must attach it to the preceding ⟦2⟧: ICICICI-, just as already before ⟦3⟧, and in the stasimon at 496 (325). The form 「「 by itself at the beginning of the colon at 918, at the end of a colon, in connection with the next in strophe and antistrophe, 920 ⟦4⟧-. But difficult is 925 ⟦5⟧ † ⟦6⟧ = 947 ⟦7⟧, according to Rossbach-Westphal consisting of nothing but three-time lengths and therefore a hexapody. What one expects, however, precisely at this penultimate place of the strophe, are dactyls, like ⟦8⟧ - -, - -, - -, -, - -, before ----; 591 likewise, but dactyls in the first four places; likewise Eumen. 387, and dactyls are also mixed in afterward in Str. ⟦9⟧, pentapody and tripodies. A tripody, to be sure consisting of nothing but spondees, I therefore assume here as well; for that the antistrophe with its six lengths must be authoritative is not doubtful. - In strophe and antistrophe there is continuous synaphea. In content, the first strophe is a general introduction to the song of blessing.

Better, however, is to insert after ⟦17⟧ a ⟦18⟧': "jewel of all Hellenes and of the gods themselves". Correctly one has referred ⟦19⟧ to the protection that Athens gave to all Hellas against the Persians, who destroyed altars and temples (⟦20⟧).
